annotations.title: Sign a timestamped receipt over a SHA-256 hash

description: Signs a timestamped receipt for a file's sha256, proving it existed unchanged then. US$0.002 per call; POST the hash. 10 free calls a day per IP, resetting at midnight UTC. Costs US$0.002 per call in USDC via x402 (Base), charged when the call answers below 400 (a no-match or not-found result is charged too); a bad request is refused unpaid. Pay by putting an x402 payment payload in _meta["x402/payment"]. Without one it uses the free trial (10 calls a day per address), then returns the payment requirements. Docs: https://vehcdj664efetfrsolne5umanq.srv.us/docs/attest

examples.note: delivery of report v3 to order 77

idempotency_key.description: Optional, x402 payments only (keys are scoped to the paying address; trial and L402 calls get 400). Retries with the same key and sha256 get the same attestation (the receipt names that call own payment tx); a different sha256 gets 409.

note.description: Optional note; only its SHA-256 goes in the receipt.

sha256.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the thing being attested.
